claim.query: Does the declared finite abstract cell contain a row system with no exact ZERO_VECTOR or OPPOSITE_PAIR Kalmanson certificate?

detector.distance_equalities: For every p,q in row(c), unordered pairs {c,p} and {c,q} are equal.
detector.inequality_order: lexicographic (i,j,k,l,kind) with i<j<k<l and kind K1 before K2
detector.opposite_pair: two nonzero reduced vectors sum coefficientwise to zero
detector.selection: first ZERO_VECTOR, otherwise first lexicographic OPPOSITE_PAIR
detector.zero_vector: the reduced coefficient vector is identically zero

abstract_coverage_requires: independent replay of every admitted refinement

refinement_contract.admission: A cut is admitted only when an exact equality-path witness makes one Kalmanson vector zero or makes two vectors opposite using only the positive row memberships negated by the cut.
refinement_contract.future_model_soundness: Any future model containing all witness memberships retains the witnessed distance equalities; further equalities preserve zero/opposite cancellation.

variables.mapping: var(c,p) = 1 + 8*c + (p if p<c else p-1), for c != p
